# TESIGN

> TESIGN Radar presents AI-selected daily tools and rising and all-time rankings, under the owner’s delegation. Stars, increases, cross-source signals, updates and licences are the evidence. AI chooses the lists under the owner’s delegation. No human review is running in September 2026. Total stars, increases, cross-source signals, last updates and licences are shown as evidence. Run by tesign, a one-person studio. No ads, paid placement, accounts or payments.

## Start here

- [Today](https://tesign.com/en/): the finite daily selection (10 items; see /en/about/ for how items are chosen)
- [About](https://tesign.com/en/about/): what TESIGN Radar is and how selection works
- [FAQ](https://tesign.com/en/faq/)
- [Explore](https://tesign.com/en/explore/): every kept product with categories, sources and signals

## Machine-readable

Every published item has a sibling index.json and index.md next to its page: /item/<slug>/index.json and /item/<slug>/index.md in Korean, /en/item/<slug>/index.json and /en/item/<slug>/index.md in English. Keys name the unit (stars, star_delta_7d, hf_likes); every figure sits next to its reference time (as_of, *_at); null means not observed, never zero. Counts are stored observations, not scores. These files are not in the sitemap.

- [Index of every published item (JSON)](https://tesign.com/data/index.json): 134 items — slug, name (ko/en), use label, category, last update and the URL of each item's HTML, JSON and Markdown; regenerated every build (2026-09-18T21:08:09.911Z); not for search indexes (robots.txt), not in the sitemap
- [Example: Atlassian MCP Server as JSON](https://tesign.com/en/item/atlassian-mcp-server/index.json): name, use label, one-liner, why / build / who / start / caveat, licence and scope, platform, categories, numbers with as_of, ranks, activity, images, source URLs, generated_at
- [Example: Atlassian MCP Server as Markdown](https://tesign.com/en/item/atlassian-mcp-server/index.md): the same fields as headed Markdown; Korean at the path without /en

## Products (English)

- [Atlassian MCP Server](https://tesign.com/en/item/atlassian-mcp-server/): Atlassian's official bridge that lets AI tools read and act on Jira, Confluence and the rest of the platform.
- [Memoh](https://tesign.com/en/item/memoh/): An open-source platform that gives every AI agent its own cloud computer, running even when your laptop is closed.
- [Coder](https://tesign.com/en/item/coder/): A self-hosted platform that moves development environments off laptops onto your own infrastructure, started on demand.
- [MemOS](https://tesign.com/en/item/memos/): A memory layer for LLM agents that unifies storing, retrieving and managing long-term memory.
- [liarjs](https://tesign.com/en/item/liarjs/): Reads what a browser says about itself, compares it with what the network actually saw, and reports every disagreement.
- [Status Trio](https://tesign.com/en/item/status-trio/): A native macOS menu bar app that merges Wi-Fi, battery and volume into a single icon.
- [OpenStock](https://tesign.com/en/item/openstock/): An open-source dashboard for tracking stock prices, company details and personalised alerts in one place.
- [ArcReel](https://tesign.com/en/item/arcreel/): A self-hosted workbench that turns a novel or script into characters, scenes, storyboards and finished short videos.
- [Harper](https://tesign.com/en/item/harper/): An English grammar checker that runs on your own machine, so what you write never leaves it.
- [Actual Budget](https://tesign.com/en/item/actual-budget/): A local-first budgeting app that keeps your finances on your own device, using envelope budgeting.

- [Wealthfolio](https://tesign.com/en/item/wealthfolio/): An open-source portfolio tracker that keeps investments, net worth and spending entirely on your device — no cloud account.
- [Capsule](https://tesign.com/en/item/capsule/): A desktop player that packs an HTML app and its data into one SQLite file — no account, no server, just a file to share.
- [MartinLoop](https://tesign.com/en/item/martin-loop/): Wraps a coding agent with a spend cap and a verifier, so "I'm done" comes with an evidence-backed receipt instead of just a claim.

- [ZapFast](https://tesign.com/en/item/zapfast/): A from-scratch Rust WhatsApp client with no browser engine — about 150MB idle RAM on Linux, versus 1.13GB for WhatsApp Web.

- [Words of Hanoi](https://tesign.com/en/item/words-of-hanoi/): A daily puzzle: move letter tiles between five tubes until every full tube spells a word.

- [diagram-design](https://tesign.com/en/item/diagram-design/): Draws 38 editorial diagram types as self-contained HTML and SVG.
- [Headroom](https://tesign.com/en/item/headroom/): Compresses tool output, logs and files before they reach the model.
- [OpenResearch](https://tesign.com/en/item/openresearch/): Runs several research agents in parallel on any model you choose.
- [open-code-review](https://tesign.com/en/item/open-code-review/): Reviews code line by line with fixed rule pipelines plus an LLM agent.
- [ecc](https://tesign.com/en/item/ecc/): Adds skills, memory and security rules to a coding agent harness.
- [Hermes Agent](https://tesign.com/en/item/hermes-agent/): Runs an agent meant to grow with the person using it.
- [OpenMontage](https://tesign.com/en/item/openmontage/): Turns a coding assistant into a full video production pipeline.
- [Worktrunk](https://tesign.com/en/item/worktrunk/): Manages Git worktrees for running several coding agents in parallel.
- [ponytail](https://tesign.com/en/item/ponytail/): Makes a coding agent ask whether the code needs writing at all.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://tesign.com/en/item/deepseek-harness/): Builds an agent harness where every capability is a plugin.
- [tokentab](https://tesign.com/en/item/tokentab/): Reads agent session logs and works out cost by model, project and day.
- [colibri](https://tesign.com/en/item/colibri/): Runs frontier MoE models on hardware you already own.
- [archify](https://tesign.com/en/item/archify/): Exports architecture and data-flow diagrams as self-contained HTML.
- [Orca](https://tesign.com/en/item/orca/): Runs a fleet of coding agents in parallel from one place.
- [Recordly](https://tesign.com/en/item/recordly/): Turns a screen recording into a polished demo video without editing.
- [gods-eye-view](https://tesign.com/en/item/gods-eye-view/): Puts real satellite and flight tracks on a 3D globe in your browser.
- [VoiceStudio](https://tesign.com/en/item/voicestudio/): Clones voices, dubs video and transcribes audio on your own machine.
